basic_info.description:
Turn Key Asset-Just recently upgraded two major improvements to this 8 Unit Apartment Building.
In 2025 Replacement of Existing Federal Pacific Electric Panels in all 8 (Eight) Apartment Units. 
Obtained and Replace One Electrical House Panel in the Garage Electrical service Area Existing Panel was removed and the New Panel was installed in its place. Second Major Improvement in 2025 (3.08) - Sleeping Area Fire Alarm Requirements (2022), Complete Replacement of the Fire Alarm System and Installation of Low Frequency Horns. 2017-"Soft Story Retrofit", per Chapter 34B -SFBC-CFC 8FD. Required Upgrade Completed of the Mandatory Earthquake Retrofit of Wood Frame Building Program. This is a two Story building with (8) Eight Garage Doors and Parking spaces in attached garages.There are two secure gated entrances which are located both on Mission Street and Morse Street. Each apartment unit is separately metered for gas and electricity for operating expenses.Natural light throughout. The location of the property provides accessibility to bus transportation on Mission Street and close proximity to both the BART Balboa and Glen Park Stations. Easy commute to nearby hospitals, universities, schools and major employers located here in the City of San Francisco and the San Francisco Bay Area.
